title: Misrepresentation prohibited.
bodyText: No person shall make a material misrepresentation or omission of a material fact in connection with the solicitation of membership of a group.
bodyHtml: §386-202  Misrepresentation prohibited.  No person shall make a material misrepresentation or omission of a material fact in connection with the solicitation of membership of a group. [L 1986, c 304, pt of §1]
